#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    if (!(cin >> n >> b)) return 0;

    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> balance(n);
    balance[0] = (a[0] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        balance[i] = balance[i - 1] + ((a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1);
    }

    vector<int> costs;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (balance[i] == 0) {
            costs.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

    int used = 0;
    int maxCuts = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < costs.size(); i++) {
        int cost = costs[i];
        if (used + cost <= b) {
            used += cost;
            maxCuts++;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << maxCuts << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
